name: Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad 推进出售其全资子公司 Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd 的全部股权给 Hextar Holdings Sdn Bhd，交易于11月24日满足先决条件；同时，公司终止了向 Widad Development (Nilai) Sdn Bhd 出售 Nilai 工业地的计划，并终止了向 KIP Real Estate Investment Trust 出售物业的协议。
overview_en: In 2026, Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad progressed the disposal of its entire equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd to Hextar Holdings Sdn Bhd, with conditions precedent fulfilled on 24 November; it also terminated the proposed disposal of industrial land in Nilai to Widad Development (Nilai) Sdn Bhd and the sale agreement with KIP Real Estate Investment Trust.

segments.name: 仓储
segments.note: 今年推进出售经营保税仓库的子公司 Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd，并终止了出售 Nilai 工业地的计划。
segments.note_en: This year, the company progressed the disposal of its bonded warehouse subsidiary Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd and terminated the proposed disposal of industrial land in Nilai.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 出售 Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd 的买卖协议先决条件于2026年11月24日达成，协议变为无条件。
actions.text_en: The conditions precedent of the share sale agreement for the disposal of Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd were fulfilled on 24 November 2026, making the agreement unconditional.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以277万令吉现金出售全资子公司 Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd 的100%股权给 Hextar Holdings Sdn Bhd。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd to Hextar Holdings Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM2.77 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Widad Development (Nilai) Sdn Bhd 双方同意终止出售 Nilai 四块工业地的买卖协议。
actions.text_en: Mutually agreed with Widad Development (Nilai) Sdn Bhd to terminate the sale and purchase agreement for the disposal of four industrial land parcels in Nilai.

segments.name: 物流
segments.note: 今年完成出售 Pasir Gudang 的工业物业（含仓库及办公室），并终止了向 KIP REIT 出售物业的协议。
segments.note_en: This year, the company completed the disposal of its industrial property in Pasir Gudang (including a warehouse and office) and terminated the property sale agreement with KIP REIT.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Channel Legion Sdn Bhd 与 KIP REIT 信托人双方同意终止物业买卖协议，因先决条件未能在约定时间内达成。
actions.text_en: Channel Legion Sdn Bhd and the trustee of KIP REIT mutually agreed to terminate the property sale and purchase agreement due to non-fulfilment of conditions precedent within the agreed timeframe.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Pengangkutan Sekata Sdn Bhd 以1600万令吉现金向 Airique Property Sdn Bhd 出售位于 Pasir Gudang, Johor 的工业物业，交易已完成。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Pengangkutan Sekata Sdn Bhd completed the disposal of its industrial property in Pasir Gudang, Johor to Airique Property Sdn Bhd for RM16 million cash.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司拟出售保税仓库子公司 Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd，退出该仓储业务。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed to dispose of its bonded warehouse subsidiary Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd, exiting the bonded warehouse business.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司通过子公司 Pengangkutan Sekata Sdn Bhd 完成出售 Pasir Gudang 工业物业，缩减物流相关物业资产。
model_changes.text_en: The company, through subsidiary Pengangkutan Sekata Sdn Bhd, completed the disposal of its Pasir Gudang industrial property, reducing logistics-related property assets.
